summary: Workday filed an 8-K reporting Q2 FY2027 earnings and announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program of up to $4.0 billion of Class A common stock. The program has no expiration, may be suspended anytime, and does not obligate repurchases. Repurchases may occur via open market, Rule 10b5-1 plans, or private negotiations. The filing includes the earnings press release as Exhibit 99.1. No specific price, premium, or timeline given. Watch for execution pace and balance-sheet impact.
